PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 404, 405, 406, 407, 409, 410, 413, 414, 415, 416, 419, 420, 421, 422, 423, 424, 427, 428, 430, 431, 432, 433, 434, 436, 437, 440, 441, 442, 443, 448, 449, 450, 452, 453, 454, 455, 456, 457, 458, 459, 460, 461, 462, 463, 464, 465, 466, 467, 468, 469, 470, 471, 472, 473, 474 and 475 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 110059, situated in the Village of Musalpitiya, Nallachchiya, Thammannagama within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 420 - Musalpitiya, 421-Nallachchiya, 424-Thammannagama in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Tham-buttegama, in the District of Anuradhapura, in the Province of North Central, referred to in Notice No. 11/0013 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1325 of 2rd January, 2004 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K. A. K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 11th October, 2018
No. 2096/42 – WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 07, 2018
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
